subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should the remaining iOS Tailscale onboarding/auth-copy changes be rebased into the current onboarding flow, split into a smaller security/auth PR, or paused in favor of the existing setup-code/Tailnet route work?
rationale: The branch changes first-run setup policy and conflicts with newly merged onboarding and Tailnet setup work, so automation should not choose the permanent UX/security direction alone.

options.title: Split residual security/auth changes
options.body: Rebase a smaller change that keeps current main’s onboarding design and route probing while adding the raw-IP block and password-missing recovery copy.

options.title: Sponsor the full path chooser
options.body: A maintainer can own the broader onboarding UX direction and ask for a full rebase, branded typography, and updated proof on current main.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: If the merged setup-code/Tailnet route work is enough for now, leave this branch unmerged and revisit only a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Split residual security/auth changes
recommendation.body: Rebase a smaller change that keeps current main’s onboarding design and route probing while adding the raw-IP block and password-missing recovery copy.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily about Tailnet setup/security policy, and steipete authored the merged Tailnet route setup work that this PR must align with.
